name: Can I replace a shattered window myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace a shattered window myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it might seem like a DIY project, replacing a shattered window, especially in the Bay Area, involves safety risks, precise measurements, and adherence to local building codes. Professionals ensure proper removal of hazardous glass, correct installation for structural integrity and energy efficiency, and compliance with regulations. Incorrect installation can lead to drafts, water leaks, and further structural issues, making professional service a safer and more reliable option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional replacement is recommended due to safety risks, precise measurements, and adherence to local building codes. Incorrect installation can lead to future issues.
